头顶上方，一道凌厉的破空声骤然响起。

数米高的梯子上，方芸双腿死死绞住木横档，半个身子悬空，手中的木弓已然拉成满月。

粗糙的木箭化作一道残影，精准无比地顺着那只毒蛛的背甲缝隙狠狠贯入，从腹下轰然穿出！巨大的动能去势不减，将紧随其后的另一只蜘蛛一并贯穿，死死钉在泥泞之中！

十去其四！

趁着后方蛛群阵型微乱的瞬间，许默一脚踹翻脚下的死蛛，猛地转身，手脚并用疯狂窜上木梯。

剩下的六只毒蛛发出愤怒的嘶鸣，潮水般涌到树下。

它们疯狂地向上跳跃，节肢在树皮上抓出道道深深的白痕，却被高度死死限制，一次次重重摔回地面。

居高临下，方芸漆黑的眸子里只剩屠戮。

弓弦嗡鸣。

咻！咻！

又是两道刺目的箭光！

树下正在蓄力起跳的两只毒蛛应声被贯穿头颅，抽搐着瘫软下去，绿色的体液流了一地。

同伴的连续死亡终于让这群冷血杀手感到了恐惧。

剩下的四只毒蛛意识到高处的猎物根本无法触及，节肢在地上烦躁地刨动几下，果断调头，朝着巢穴孔洞的方向疯狂逃窜。

方芸冷眸一横。

“想跑？”

手指在箭袋上带起一连串残影，弓弦剧烈震颤，几乎连成一声长音。

四支利箭首尾相接！

噗！噗！

跑在最后面的两只毒蛛被瞬间钉穿腹部，翻滚着死在枯叶堆里。

第三只毒蛛发出一声凄厉的惨叫，一条粗壮的节肢被生生射断，流着粘液滚进了一旁的灌木丛。

只有跑在最前面的最后一只毒蛛，连滚带爬地一头扎进那个布满肉膜的孔洞之中，彻底没了动静。

这场搏杀，头尾不过短短两三分钟。

许默死死趴在粗糙的木梯横档上，胸膛剧烈起伏。

汗水早已浸透了内衬，风一扫，刺骨凉。

头顶上方，方芸垂下的右臂微不可察地打着摆子。连续高强度地拉满木弓，几乎抽干了这具躯体所有的爆发力。

树冠下方，九团散发着令人作呕腥臭的漆黑残骸，凌乱地铺在腐殖质上。

浓绿色的体液正肆无忌惮地腐蚀着枯叶，发出阵阵嘶嘶声。

许默反手摸出水袋丢了上去。

“太惊险了。”

趁着喘息的功夫，他的视线迅速锁定下方残缺的虫尸。

【怪物·剧毒蜘蛛】

Above his head, a sharp sound broke through the air suddenly.

On a ladder several meters high, Fang Yun's legs were tightly tied to the wooden rungs, half of her body was hanging in the air, and the wooden bow in her hand was already stretched into a full moon.

The rough wooden arrow turned into an afterimage, penetrated with great precision along the gap in the poisonous spider's carapace, and burst out from under the abdomen!The huge kinetic energy continued unabated and penetrated the other spider that followed, nailing it to the mud!

Four out of ten!

Taking advantage of the moment when the formation of the spiders behind him was slightly chaotic, Xu Mo kicked the dead spiders under his feet, turned around suddenly, and ran up the wooden ladder frantically with his hands and feet.

The remaining six poisonous spiders roared angrily and swarmed under the tree.

They jumped upward wildly, their jointed limbs scratching deep white marks on the bark of the tree, but they were restricted by the height and fell back to the ground hard again and again.

Standing down from a high position, Fang Yun's dark eyes only saw slaughter.

The bowstring hums.

call out!call out!

Two more dazzling arrows!

The two poisonous spiders under the tree that were gathering strength to take off were stabbed through the head, twitching and paralyzed, and green body fluids flowed all over the floor.

The continuous deaths of their companions finally frightened this group of cold-blooded killers.

The remaining four poisonous spiders realized that the prey at high places could not be reached at all. Their jointed limbs pawed at the ground a few times, then they turned around decisively and fled madly in the direction of the hole in the nest.

Fang Yun cast a cold glance.

"Want to run?"

The fingers brought up a series of afterimages on the quiver, and the bowstring vibrated violently, almost making a long sound.

Four sharp arrows connected end to end!

puff!puff!

The two poisonous spiders running at the back were instantly nailed through their abdomens and rolled to death in a pile of dead leaves.

The third poisonous spider let out a shrill scream, and one of its thick limbs was shot off, and it rolled into the bushes next to it, dripping with mucus.

Only the last poisonous spider running at the front plunged into the hole covered with fleshy membranes, rolling and crawling, and completely stopped moving.

This fight lasted only two or three minutes.

Xu Mo lay flat on the rough wooden ladder rung, his chest rising and falling violently.

Sweat had already soaked through the lining, and when the wind swept away, it was biting and cold.

Above her head, Fang Yun's hanging right arm was swinging imperceptibly.Continuously pulling the wooden bow with high intensity almost drained all the explosive power from this body.

Beneath the tree crown, nine groups of pitch-black remains exuding a disgusting stench were spread messily on the humus.

The thick green body fluid was corroding the dead leaves unscrupulously, making bursts of hissing sounds.

Xu Mo took out the water bag and threw it in.

"It's so thrilling."

Taking advantage of his breath, his eyes quickly locked onto the mutilated insect corpse below.
